items.headline: Scoping meeting set for Oakmead Parkway housing project's environmental review
items.summary: The city is holding a public scoping meeting for the environmental impact report on a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway, giving residents an early chance to weigh in on what the review should cover.

items.headline: Six new single-family homes permitted on Adeline Avenue
items.summary: Six separate 'Phase 3.1 Comm Hill' new-home permits were issued for addresses 802–822 Adeline Avenue, ranging from $474,096 to $512,234 in valuation, each for a single housing unit. The shared phase name and issue date suggest a coordinated small subdivision build-out rather than isolated infill.
